title: Practice混合证据契约范围补充评审

facts.review_clarification: Hydrate only course evidence does not mean allow only course evidence. Trusted external evidence uses the already-created bounded EvidenceItem summary without database hydration or new network/tool activity.

course_evidence.selection: Already present in this request's answer_evidence
course_evidence.authorization: Current course, exact retrieved document_id and chunk_id, document and chunk INDEXED

required_checks: Evidence was created by the current run's existing trusted tool path
tool_name is server-known and maps to the normalized resource_type
source_id is correlated with the current run's successful server-recorded tool observation evidence_ids and provenance_verified=true
trusted_external_evidence.content: Reuse only the existing sanitized bounded EvidenceItem text

mixed_grounding.allowed_claim_types: course plus explicitly required verified external types
mixed_grounding.required_source_coverage: At least one valid claim for every normalized required source type

allowed_implementation: Split practice evidence preparation into authorized course hydration and verified external-summary reuse
Correlate external evidence with current-run trusted tool provenance without new tool or network calls
Build request-scoped spans for both evidence classes
Add practice-specific allowed-source and required-source coverage validation without changing ordinary GroundedSpanAnswer behavior
Migrate the orchestration test provider and authorized INDEXED course fixture while preserving course+paper semantics
Expand the Phase3 knowledge fixture to seven explicit fields and six defensive local steps

targeted: course+paper positive with seven fields, six steps, two real source citations, and required paper coverage
external evidence causes no database hydration, new network access, or second tool call

full_suite.skips_xfails_warnings: Report separately and do not count as passed; no unexplained new skip

forbidden: Accept externally supplied trust or provenance assertions without the server tool chain
Refetch external data or full text
Modify public API, database, frontend, configuration, or timeouts
Weaken seven-field binding, span validation, support checks, or Guard thresholds
scope_stop: If implementation requires any file or behavior outside this addendum, output SCOPE_REVIEW_REQUIRED and stop.
